profile.Name: Hooch the Bootlegger
profile.Personality: A man of few words who saves his strength for battle and leaves the talking to Mick the Grip. He judges by deeds, admires spine, and holds the killing of a brother in arms as the gravest sin.
profile.Backstory: Leader of the Hook Raiders. He calls himself a pirate and leads the Hook Raiders from Kopek, robbing the United Cities across the Hook in fast raids on towns, traders, and outposts before vanishing back to the sea. He wants the Emperor, Longen, and Lady Merin of Drifter's Last dead, and he sees the United Cities as a bloated beast to bring down with a thousand small cuts. He trains Calvin, whom he adopted.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Grumbles more than he talks and opens with one-word verdicts such as "Reverence." or "Amusement." Calls on the sea in battle, crying "Spirit of the Sea, bestow me strength!", and calls trusted allies "kin".
